categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Liance Electromechanical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent testing equipment for power systems, along with providing power system testing and verification services. Its products and services cater to sectors including new energy vehicles, fuel vehicles, marine, and aviation power systems. The company also engages in related equipment such as balancing machines and vibration detection devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced modular design, customization, and simulation technologies for hardware development, including high-torque, high-speed, high-power, high-precision, and high-dynamic response testing equipment. It has independently developed proprietary software platforms supporting comprehensive testing processes with features like automatic testing, high-speed data recording, cloud storage, and compatibility with industry standards (INCA, ASAM, ASAP3). Key technologies include electric dynamometer integration, fast connection and assembly testing, gearbox testing, containerized test rooms, and high-speed hydraulic dynamometers for aviation engines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's main customers are manufacturers and research institutes in the new energy vehicle sector (e.g., SAIC, GAC, Huawei, NIO, BYD, Xiaomi), fuel vehicle sector (e.g., Weichai Group, Geely, FAW, Dongfeng), marine sector (e.g., Weichai Heavy Machinery, China Shipbuilding Group), and aviation sector (e.g., China Aviation Development Group, AVIC). It serves OEMs and component suppliers for powertrains, engines, transmissions, and related systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with key facilities and customers located in regions such as Jiangsu (Nantong, Suzhou), Shanghai, Zhejiang, Anhui, Hubei, and Fujian. It serves domestic markets extensively and has limited overseas exposure.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Liance operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the power system testing supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of testing equipment and provision of testing services to OEMs and component manufacturers. It procures core raw materials and components from upstream suppliers, including international brands, and delivers customized testing solutions to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on intelligent testing equipment for new energy vehicles and aviation power systems. It pursues breakthroughs in high-speed hydraulic dynamometers, electric dynamometers, fast connection technologies, and software platforms. The strategic '124 Project' aims to establish the company as an internationally leading and domestically dominant enterprise by enhancing industrial development, new energy industry competitiveness, CNAS testing bases, and intelligent manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized intelligent testing equipment and provision of testing and verification services. The company also earns income from sales of spare parts, maintenance services, and balancing machines. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales with some distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international and domestic power system testing equipment manufacturers. While international firms hold a technological lead, especially in aviation engine testing, Jiangsu Liance has established a strong domestic presence with recognized technology and brand reputation. It is a pioneer in domestic aviation hydraulic dynamometer technology and has secured contracts with leading Chinese OEMs, positioning itself as a leading domestic player with growing international competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 495.1 million, a 32.56% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 90.66 million, up 11.61%. Total assets reached RMB 1.256 billion, growing 10.73% from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for 7.46% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile with steady profitability and expanding scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly customized, modular intelligent testing solutions with proprietary software platforms that integrate hardware and software for comprehensive power system testing. Its products feature high precision, dynamic response, and automation capabilities, supporting diverse testing scenarios including environmental simulation and energy flow analysis. The company emphasizes domestic innovation, import substitution, and close collaboration with leading OEMs to deliver cost-effective, reliable, and technologically advanced testing equipment and services.
